paragraphs.source_en: A Brief History of A Brief History* I am still rather taken aback by the reception given to my book, A Brief History of Time. It has been on The New York Times bestseller list for thirty-seven weeks and on The Sunday Times list for twenty-eight weeks. (It was published later in Britain than in die United States.) It is being translated into twenty languages (twenty-one if you count American as different from English). This was much more than I expected when I first had the idea in 1982 of writing a popular book about the universe. My intention was partly to earn money to pay my daughter's school fees. (In fact, by the time the book actually appeared, she was in her last year of school.)
